a: Miiles is an artificial intelligence platform for entrepreneurs that turns ideas into business models. Describe your idea and Miiles generates your Business Model Canvas, flows and to-do lists on a visual board you can edit with your team.
In Discoveries you also learn how the TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook algorithms work, and which strategies growing creators are using.

You write your idea the way you'd tell it to someone. If needed, the AI asks a few questions to understand your goal, proposes a strategic plan and, once you approve it, builds the board with your business structure.
Then you can edit, move and expand each part, or ask the AI to develop a section from what you already have.

faq_items.q: What is a Business Model Canvas?
a: It's a strategy tool created by Alexander Osterwalder that sums up a business in nine blocks: customer segments, value proposition, channels, customer relationships, revenue streams, key resources, key activities, key partners and cost structure.
Miiles generates it from your idea so you can review, adjust and share it in minutes.

faq_items.q: Can I validate my business idea with AI?
a: Miiles helps you structure your idea and see clearly what you need to test: who your customer is, what problem you solve, which channel reaches them and how you make money.
Real validation happens when you talk to your customers; Miiles gives you the map to do it in order.

faq_items.q: Do I need to know strategy or write prompts?
a: No. You don't need to master business strategy prompts: you write in plain language and Miiles takes care of the questions and the structure.
If you already know strategy, you can ask for specific frameworks, like the Business Model Canvas, and adjust each block your way.
You can start for free. The Pro plan costs MXN 386 per month or MXN 3,712 per year (save 20%) and includes unlimited projects and collaborations, advanced analytics and priority support.
For teams and companies there's a custom Business plan.
